;Law and crime
*[[Sutherland Springs church shooting]]
**Officials from the FBI and Texas law enforcement are searching for the motive of the gunman who opened fire in a Baptist church, killing 26 people and injuring 20 others. [https://www.today.com/video/today-s-headlines-nov-6-2017-1089369155980 (Todays)]
*[[Immigration to the United States]], [[United States Citizenship and Immigration Services]]
**United States Attorney General [[Jeff Sessions]] intends on stripping the U.S. citizenship of four [[Somali Americans]] allegedly abusing the [[Diversity Immigrant Visa]] by pretending to be a family. The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump Administration]] earlier said it plans to scrap the visa program. [http://freebeacon.com/issues/doj-announces-denaturalization-complaints-somali-diversity-visa-immigrants/ (''Washington Free Beacon'')]
**The [[United States Department of Homeland Security]] announces that it will end [[temporary protected status]] for thousands of [[Nicaraguans|Nicaraguan]] migrants while decisions await for thousands more from [[El Salvador]], [[Haiti]] and [[Honduras]]. [https://www.buzzfeed.com/adolfoflores/nicaraguan-immigrants-to-lose-temporary-protected-status (BuzzFeed)]

**[[Solomon Islands]] [[Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands|Prime Minister]] [[Manasseh Sogavare]] is narrowly ousted in a vote of no confidence by 27 to 23 votes. *[[Icelandic parliamentary election, 2017]]
**[[Left-Green Movement]] leader [[Katrín Jakobsdóttir]] fails to form a government after the breakdown of talks with her proposed four-party coalition. [https://news.sky.com/story/iceland-remains-without-a-government-as-left-led-coalition-talks-break-down-11116558 (Sky News)]
*[[Politics of Zimbabwe]]
**[[Emmerson Mnangagwa]] is fired as Vice President by [[Zimbabwe]] President [[Robert Mugabe]]. The public and the media widely perceives Mugabe's wife [[Grace Mugabe|Grace]] as his likely successor after his death with Mnangagwa having been seen as her rival. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/06/zimbabwe-robert-mugabe-vice-president-emmerson-mnangagwa-grace-mugabe (''The Guardian'')]
